notes:
I couldn't write these notes. Every attempt to read a source failed, so I have no material for any verse.

I tried to open five pages: the Enduring Word commentary on Amos 9, three Bible Hub commentary pages (verses 1, 7 and 11) and the Precept Austin page for Amos 9. Each request came back as a bare text string rather than page content, so nothing loaded. When I tried again to see what was going wrong, the tool told me I had used up my search and fetch calls for this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read no pages, writing notes now would mean making up content and links, so I've left them out.

If you send another message, I can start over. I'll begin with the main verse-by-verse sources: Enduring Word, the Bible Hub and StudyLight commentaries (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit) and Precept Austin. I'd then look at the verses where views differ most:
- **Verse 7:** Israel being compared with the Cushites, Philistines and Arameans.
- **Verses 11–12:** the "fallen tent of David," and how James quotes it in Acts 15. Reformed, Baptist, Pentecostal and Catholic writers read this differently, and some modern teaching on "restoring the tabernacle of David" (often about worship) is debated.
- **Verses 13–15:** whether the promise of being planted in the land is read literally for national Israel or as fulfilled in the church.

If you can paste text from any of these pages, I can also work directly from that.
